retired_controls.reason: This control belongs to the prior issue-specific delivery lineage and its risk surface is not required by the current issue #1246 presentation contract.
retired_controls.evidence: Revalidado no pacote current-target da PR 1276; o controle histórico permanece explicitamente retired e não é reutilizado como produto.
retired_controls.procedure: Compare the prior control risk binding against the current requirement closure and current-target package identity.
retired_controls.expected: Foreign issue-specific controls are explicitly retired rather than silently reused.
retired_controls.observed: The current closure does not require the prior control risk family/surface, so the inherited control is retired with an explicit disposition.
